basic_info.description: Splendid Glen Park contemporary residence featuring a versatile and highly livable floor plan w/4BRs, 3.5 baths, and multiple living and entertaining spaces. Constructed w/high-quality materials and finishes, designed for maximum natural light plus many modern conveniences and smart home features. The result - a very special home that is at once elegant, contemporary, and refined, but also exceedingly comfortable, functional, and welcoming. Main level: open-concept chef's kitchen, living and dining rooms with a wall of south-facing glass doors to balcony overlooking the garden, and powder room. Top level: 3 BRs. South-facing en-suite primary w/spacious walk-in closet, additional closet, and bath w/dual vanity, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. 2 bedrooms with large closets and another full bath w/dual vanity and shower over tub. Laundry room separates primary en-suite from front bedrooms. Below main level: 4th BR, LR/den w/kitchenette, office, and full bath w/walk-in shower. Garden level: spacious family room w/2 large closets and direct access to backyard. 2-car garage w/dual-car elevator and EV charger. Radiant floor heating system w/ multiple zones on each floor. Situated in the heart of Glen Park, a short walk to the Village, BART, and the Canyon. Easy freeway access.
